landing.title: Chat with your company's documents
landing.subtitle: Upload a policy or handbook and ask questions in plain language — every answer cites the exact file and page, and says "I don't know" when it's not in your documents.
landing.guestNote: No signup needed. Guest mode: 1 file up to 1 MB and a few questions.
landing.feature1Body: Every reply cites the exact file and page it came from — no black-box guessing.
landing.feature2Body: It answers only from the documents you upload, and clearly says when it doesn't know.
landing.feature3Body: Your documents stay yours — isolated per account with row-level security.

workspace.allDocumentsHint: Ask across all your uploaded documents at once.
workspace.allDocumentsInfo: “All documents” is selected — the assistant analyzes every PDF you've uploaded together and cites the source for each answer.
workspace.previewErroredBody: This document failed to process, so it can't be previewed or used in chat. Re-index it or remove it.
workspace.uploadLimitReached: File limit reached on your plan.
workspace.storageError: Not enough storage — this file would exceed your {size} limit.
workspace.uploadQueued: Document added — indexing in the background…
workspace.chatError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
workspace.chatWelcomeBody: Ask about your company policies, handbook, and onboarding docs. I answer only from the documents you've uploaded and cite the source for every answer — I can't help with topics outside them.
workspace.chatScopedAll: Searching across all your uploaded documents — ask anything.

workspace.chatScopedFolder: Searching in the "{name}" folder — ask about its documents.
